question: What type of bridge is the new Pamban Rail Bridge, inaugurated in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vertical lift bridge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The new **Pamban Rail Bridge** is **India’s first vertical lift sea bridge**, a state-of-the-art engineering marvel connecting the **Indian mainland** at **Mandapam** to **Pamban Island** (Rameswaram) in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The bridge’s most distinctive feature is its **72.5-meter-long vertical lift span**. This central section can be raised vertically to a height of **17 meters** above the water level, allowing large **ships and vessels** to pass through the **Palk Strait** seamlessly.
 
• Constructed by **Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL)**, the bridge spans a total length of approximately **2.05 kilometers** and consists of **99 spans** supported by **100 piers** located in the sea.
